tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind panes, cards and the graph. Also the fill of quiet chips on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, toolbars, graph nodes, inputs. Also the text color on filled keyword tags and step numbers.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `surface` and every `-soft` fill. Stroke of the selected graph node.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `bg` and `surface`: captions, line ranges, inactive tabs, default graph edges.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on `bg` and `surface`. Decorative only; never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Column rules in the dependency map.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive color: links, active controls, focus ring, exported symbols, and 'depends on' in a focused graph. Text on `surface`, `bg` and `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind active controls, event chips and dependency highlights. Carries `accent` or `ink` text.

tokens.name: user
tokens.usage: 'Used by' in a focused graph and the current-line marker in code. Always paired with `accent`; the two differ in lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: user-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind dependents and the highlighted code line. Carries `ink` text.

tokens.name: ext
tokens.usage: Anything imported from outside the file: external chips, module nodes, external edges. Text on `surface` and `ext-soft`.

tokens.name: ext-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of external chips and module headers.

tokens.name: method
tokens.usage: Calls to controller methods and local helpers in a call flow.

tokens.name: method-soft
tokens.usage: Reserved fill for method highlights.

tokens.name: cond
tokens.usage: Conditional frames in a call flow (if, else, ternary, short-circuit) and early returns.

tokens.name: cond-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of conditional frames. Carries `ink` and `muted` text.

tokens.name: loop
tokens.usage: Loop frames in a call flow.

tokens.name: loop-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of loop frames.

tokens.name: try
tokens.usage: Try and finally frames in a call flow.

tokens.name: try-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of try frames.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Possible bugs, catch frames, throw exits and the error path. Never used for decoration.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of warning notes and catch frames. Carries `ink` text.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Background of code blocks.

tokens.name: tok-kw
tokens.usage: Keywords in code on `code-bg`, and the async/await tag.

tokens.name: tok-str
tokens.usage: String literals in code on `code-bg`.

tokens.name: tok-num
tokens.usage: Numeric literals in code on `code-bg`.

tokens.name: tok-type
tokens.usage: Type names in code on `code-bg`.

tokens.name: tok-com
tokens.usage: Comments and line numbers in code on `code-bg`. Source value kept: about 3:1 on `code-bg`, below 4.5:1, so never use it for text a reader must not miss.

families.display: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "Arial Narrow", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above a block and graph column heads.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Wraps every agent-harness execution in diagnostics.
styles.usage: Descriptions and running text, at most 72 characters wide.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Meta lines under a call-flow step.

styles.name: mono-tag
styles.usage: Uppercase keyword tags on flow frames and exits.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between algorithm steps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar controls and stat pills; vertical padding of buttons.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap inside a card and between a tag and its label.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a group; horizontal padding of buttons and steps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of cards; edge inset of floating controls.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of cards; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Top padding of a scrolling pane.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Side gutter of panes and the header.

tokens.name: space-34
tokens.usage: Indent of calls that run inside another call.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, keyword tags.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Notes, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-7
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, code blocks, graph nodes.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Call-flow steps and floating legends.

tokens.name: radius-9
tokens.usage: Function cards.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: Flow frames and the overview panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Stat pills and phase tags.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only on a call-flow step while it is flying into place. Nothing at rest has a shadow.
